content: For EGFR exon 19 deletion or exon 21 L858R mutations, osimertinib (Category 1) is the preferred first-line therapy for metastatic NSCLC. Dose: 80mg orally once daily.

Osimertinib is indicated for first-line treatment of adult patients with metastatic NSCLC whose tumors have EGFR exon 19 deletions or exon 21 L858R mutations. Recommended dose: 80mg orally once daily.
Alectinib (Category 1) is the preferred first-line agent for ALK-positive metastatic NSCLC. Dose: 600mg orally twice daily with food.
Sotorasib or adagrasib are recommended for patients with KRAS G12C-mutated NSCLC who have received prior platinum-based chemotherapy.
Pembrolizumab monotherapy is recommended for treatment-naive metastatic NSCLC with PD-L1 TPS >= 50% and no actionable driver mutations.
Alectinib is indicated for ALK-positive metastatic NSCLC. Grade 3-4 adverse reactions include myalgia, elevated CPK, and bradycardia. Dose reduction to 450mg BID for Grade 3 toxicity.
Selpercatinib is the preferred agent for RET fusion-positive metastatic NSCLC. Dose: 160mg orally twice daily.
Tepotinib or capmatinib are recommended for MET exon 14 skipping mutations in metastatic NSCLC.
